name: com.gameframex.unity.mono
description:
GameFrameX Mono — Unity MonoBehaviour lifecycle bridge package. Exposes Update, FixedUpdate, LateUpdate, Destroy, OnApplicationPause and OnApplicationFocus to non-MonoBehaviour systems through a listener registration pattern; focus/pause changes are additionally broadcast as pooled event args through the event bus. Listener exceptions are isolated so one failing callback never blocks the rest. The component stays a thin forwarding entry; the module is reachable directly via GetModule<T>() / GameApp.Mono. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Mono — Unity MonoBehaviour 生命周期桥接功能包。通过监听器注册模式将 Update、FixedUpdate、LateUpdate、Destroy、OnApplicationPause 与 OnApplicationFocus 暴露给非 MonoBehaviour 系统，焦点/暂停变化同时以池化事件参数经事件总线广播。监听器异常相互隔离，单个回调出错不阻断其余回调。组件保留为纯转发薄入口，模块可经 GetModule<T>() / GameApp.Mono 直达。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
